gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-khudawa: Plakkaat is heavy and closed, its terminals curling round to nearly touch the stem. And Noto Sans Khudawadi leaves its rounds unsealed, like an unlatched hook, so a long passage reads friendly and light.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-kr: Heavy, bent-straw letters up top, all the same thickness from corner to curve. Noto Sans KR sits below with generous gaps and a big x-height.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao lifts its x-height well above the usual. Plakkaat is closed and heavy where this body stays open, and that gap is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-lao-loo: Plakkaat hits hard, its horizontals as heavy as its verticals. Noto Sans Lao Looped follows with words that form solid blocks rather than skylines, so a long passage feels dense but smooth.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Chunky, closed and stencil-like. Plakkaat holds one stroke thickness throughout, while Noto Sans Lepcha opens its curves wide and stands its lowercase tall like cast iron capitals; that closed-versus-open split is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Stencil-cut weight, flat and unflinching. Plakkaat stays closed and constant in every channel, while Noto Sans Limbu gapes open in its curves and stretches its small letters tall, and that tension is the strength here.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase and opens its curves like a sprung paper clip. Under Plakkaat's closed, unmodulated heft, a longer read feels easy.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-mahajan: Plakkaat draws a single-width stroke in every glyph, heavy and bent like straw. Noto Sans Mahajani stands its lowercase tall with a funnel-wide throat in the e, so a larger heading size would suit the contrast.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-malayal: Heavy and closed, Plakkaat bends its terminals round toward the stem. Noto Sans Malayalam lets the middle zone dominate each line and gives its s generous openings, which loosens the page below.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Stencil-cut and blunt, Plakkaat keeps one steady width throughout. Noto Sans Mandaic lifts its lowercase close to the capitals with curvy, unclamped letters, so a longer passage moves along smoothly.
